ongoing_phase_1.merger_name: Calvary – 14 Healthscope hospitals and Healthscope Independence Services
ongoing_phase_1.merger_description: Little Company of Mary Health Care Ltd (**Calvary**), through a wholly owned subsidiary, proposes to acquire 14 private hospitals, together with Healthscope Independence Services and all head office and centralised corporate support functions from Healthscope (the **Acquisition**).

Stellex Partners III LP (Stellex) and OrbeNovo Advisory LLP (ONA) propose to acquire the entire issued share capital of Buchan 2 Ltd, the holding company for Score Group Limited and its subsidiaries (together, "Score").

ongoing_phase_2.merger_description: Saipem S.p.A (**Saipem**) proposes to merge with Subsea7 S.A (**Subsea7**) (the **Acquisition**).

Zoetis Holdings LLC (**Zoetis**), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Zoetis Inc., proposes to acquire the global animal genomic testing business (**Neogen Genomics**) of Neogen Corporation (the **Acquisition**).

ongoing_public_benefit.merger_description: Insurance Australia Group (**IAG**) proposes to acquire 100% of the issued share capital in RAC Insurance (**RACI**) from RACI Pty Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Royal Automobile Club of Western Australia Inc (**RAC**) (the **Acquisition**). The Acquisition does not include RAC's roadside assistance business which will continue to be operated independently by RAC.
